details.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash is Google DeepMind's newest Flash-tier model in the Gemini 3 family, released 2 September 2026 and built on Gemini 3.7 Flash with performance advancements across software engineering and agentic knowledge workflows. It accepts text, image, audio and video input over up to a 1M-token context window and continues to support customizable effort levels to trade off response quality, cost and latency. As of 24 September 2026, Google's Gemini API docs list it as the newest stable release in the Flash line, with Gemini 3.7 Flash marked as the previous generation.
advantages: Scores 89.4% on Terminal-bench 2.1 for agentic terminal coding, per its Google DeepMind model card.
Scores 87.8% on LVBench in agentic mode for long video understanding, per its Google DeepMind model card.
Scores 73.7% on DeepSWE v1.1 for long-horizon software engineering, per its Google DeepMind model card.
Scores 61.4% on the Vals Finance Agent v2 benchmark for financial-analyst tasks, per its Google DeepMind model card.
Scores 86.2% on LABBench2 for real-world biology research tasks, per its Google DeepMind model card.
disadvantages: Knowledge cutoff of March 2026, with some domains limited to January 2025, per its Google DeepMind model card.
Its model card notes it may use more tokens to maximize performance, especially at higher effort levels.
Its model card lists hallucinations typical of foundation models and occasional slowness or timeout issues as known limitations.
use_cases: Long-horizon software engineering and agentic coding tasks

notes: Catalog facts (1,048,576 input tokens, 65,536 output tokens, audio+image+text input) match the model card's 'up to 1M' input / '64K' output figures, but the card also lists video file input, which the catalog's modality list does not include. ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models (last updated 2026-09-24) marks Gemini 3.8 Flash 'New Stable' and, as of that date, it is the newest Flash-tier model with no announced successor; the deprecations page lists a release date of September 2, 2026 and no shutdown date, matching the catalog's empty deprecation_date. Benchmark scores were taken only from the 'Gemini 3.8 Flash' column of the model card's comparison table, not the sibling Gemini 3.7 Flash, Claude Opus/Sonnet or GPT columns shown alongside it. Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark 'all-pass rate' (10.0%) was left out of evaluations since the name reads misleadingly as a generic pass rate rather than the demanding all-steps-correct metric Google defines it as.
